title: DWP v6 plan snapshot (state.json projection)
description: The deterministic snapshot projection of a v6 plan: rebuilt only by shared/ledger.py (project) from contract + journal.ndjson, atomically (temp + rename + fsync). Every timestamp derives from event ts values, never the wall clock, so replaying the same journal bytes yields a byte-identical snapshot. New schema-URL generation per RFC 9.1: not a mutation of the v5 plan-state shapes. Task statuses are pending/in_progress as emitted today; completion states land with the lifecycle wiring and will widen this enum in the same generation before release.

updated_at.description: The latest event ts the projection covers; empty before the first event.

positions.description: Latest journal seq per event type (provenance types excluded). A position the journal cannot support after a markdown-wins reconciliation is recorded regenerated, never fabricated.

limits.description: The contract's declared resource envelope limits, carried verbatim (the contract schema owns their shape).

checkpoint.description: The latest open question an operator must answer; null when none is recorded.

blocker.description: The recorded blocker statement; null when the plan is not blocked.

archives.description: Journal roll archives beside the plan (nothing is ever deleted; snapshot-cited positions stay addressable).

started_seq.description: The task_start event's journal position; null before the task starts.

via_seq.description: The in-window evidence event's journal position.

evidence_path.description: Recoverable pointer to the evidence log, relative to the plan directory.

stale_seqs.description: Pre-start evidence events for this criterion: recorded history that can never satisfy the in-window rule.

regenerated.description: The snapshot cites this position but the journal cannot support it (markdown-wins regeneration); ignored for roll bounding.

value.description: The sampled amount as recorded by the metering source; untyped because limit kinds differ.
